name: Quantoz USDQ
oneLiner: USDQ is Quantoz Payments' MiCA-authorized dollar e-money token, backed by cash, deposits, and EU and U.S. government bonds.
collateral: U.S. dollar deposits and government bonds (Netherlands, Germany, US) held in segregated, bankruptcy-remote accounts at Tier 1 European banks by Stichting Quantoz, supervised by DNB; reserve ratio disclosed on Quantoz's transparency page
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through Quantoz Payments for onboarded customers; reserves are disclosed against circulating supply on the Quantoz transparency page

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Quantoz's USDQ disclosure describes direct 1:1 redemption for onboarded customers and a segregated reserve of cash deposits and government bonds. The disclosed 30% cash and 70% government-bond allocation supports the fiat-cash classification. The reviewed materials do not provide an independent current assurance opinion, full bank/custodian identity, or complete legal claim and insolvency treatment, so no stronger mechanism-component conclusion is made.
